items.title: Stock Market Today: Dow Rises As Warsh Speech Wraps; Microsoft Breaks Out, Workday Jumps (Live Coverage)
items.summary: The Dow Jones Industrial Average edged higher early Friday as Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh wrapped up his speech at the Fed's annual symposium in Jackson Hole, Wyo. Meanwhile, Rubrik, Marvell Technology, Affirm, Elastic and PayPal were big movers on the stock market today.

items.title: Stripe, Advent suspend their pursuit of PayPal
items.summary: Stripe and Advent had bid to acquire the payments firm for about $53 billion, an offer PayPal's board reportedly rejected. An analyst says that puts pressure on PayPal's new leadership to boost performance.
